hero.title: Axopar 37 Sun Top
hero.heading: Axopar 37 Sun Top
hero.intro: The Axopar 37 Sun Top, with its multi-purpose characteristics, is an all-rounder that combines perfect protection and open space. Enjoying a great day in the sun with family, savouring ‘al-fresco’ dining, having a party with friends, or for those who love the feeling of running an open boat but still being protected from the weather. The 37 Sun Top has proved to be the perfect choice, easily justifying its position as a true game-changer.

sections.title: The Market Leader Revolutionized
sections.intro: The versatile Axopar 37 with its distinctive and instantly recognisable looks is the perfect partner for all adventures at sea. It provides responsive, thrilling and sporty handling that will safely take you anywhere in supreme comfort and style. Featuring intuitive solutions, enhanced driving dynamics, flexible accommodation together with a whole new space experience.

sections.title: Driver in Focus
sections.intro: New intuitive solutions that bring the driving experience even closer to the ease and simplicity of driving a car. Redefined ergonomics contribute to a supremely practical and functional layout, with excellent all-round visibility. The driver-focused helm, with its clean and uncluttered dashboard, ensures the skipper will always remain in full control.

sections.title: Significant Performance Gains
sections.intro: Up to 30% better fuel-economy across the 20 to 40 knot speed range, compared to the predecessor. Resulting in an extended cruising range, on average with 35% or +75 additional nautical miles. Up to +35% increase in ‘comfortable’ and most efficient cruising speed at steady 3500rpm, up from 22knots to 29 knots

sections.title: The Gullwing Door Concept
sections.intro: The Gullwing Doors redefine how an enclosed front cabin can be best utilized to provide a more sociable feeling and full interaction with one’s surroundings, making the front cabin feel like it's part of the outdoors. Now it is possible to fully interact with and appreciate the outside surroundings like never before.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.name: Multipurpose Roof
items.title: Multipurpose Roof
items.text: The extended roof offers weather protection when needed. By opening the large sliding canvas roof, you can enjoy sunshine in the entire helm and cockpit area.

items.name: Built-in Electric Toilet
items.title: Built-in Electric Toilet
items.text: The built-in electric flush toilet with an 70l septic tank is easily accessible under the L-sofa in front cabin.

items.name: Spacious Fore Deck
items.title: Spacious Fore Deck
items.text: The spacious fore deck is a perfect place to socialize with family and friends. A large anchor box in the bow will hold the anchor, fenders, and ropes easily, as well as other equipment you need for your journey.

items.name: Walkaround Deck
items.title: Walkaround Deck
items.text: A walk-around layout with safe passageways for easy movement onboard, combined with reduced thresholds, makes life onboard functional and safe for both young and old.

items.name: Cabinet in Front Cabin
items.title: Cabinet in Front Cabin
items.text: A cabinet is standard and can be extended with the optional sink and faucet. There is also a mirror above the cabinet and 4 x pop-up clothes hangers standard.

items.name: Gullwing Doors
items.title: Gullwing Doors
items.text: Gullwing doors redefine how an enclosed front cabin can be utilised to create a more sociable environment and encourage full interaction with one’s surroundings, making the front cabin feel like it's part of the outdoors.

items.name: Additional Overnight Possibilities
items.title: Additional Overnight Possibilities
items.text: The spacious optional aft cabin sleeps two people comfortably. Upgrade the aft cabin’s looks and style with an optional comfort package.

items.name: Multi-storage
items.title: Multi-storage
items.text: Large storage compartment on aft deck. Lockable large hatch with gas strut supports. Rope holders inside the hatch. Additional 2 x LED deck lights inside storage compartment. Water-resistant carpet in black. Additional sun deck and backrest cushions can be ordered in Silvertex fabric.

items.name: Sun Bed on Foredeck
items.title: Sun Bed on Foredeck
items.text: Wide sun bed mattress and backrest in Silvertex fabric with diamond pattern stitching for the fore deck. Openable and lockable storage box under sunbed in GRP. Including a harbour cover for the sun bed.

items.name: Sun Shades
items.title: Sun Shades
items.text: Sun shades with stainless steel supports are available for both fore and aft decks, perfect for providing additional shade on hot summer days (for stationary use only).

items.name: Toilet Compartment
items.title: Toilet Compartment
items.text: An optional fully enclosed toilet compartment with the standard toilet bowl moved to the starboard side, mounted transversely. Corian top with sink, faucet, and a small storage compartment. Further upgradable with an optional shower compartment.

items.name: Driver Experience
items.title: Driver Experience
items.text: A clean and uncluttered helm station creates a driving sensation similar to the feel and simplicity of driving a car. The station is extendable with optional Glass Bridge/Information Display touch screens.

items.name: Significant Fuel-Consumption Gains
items.title: Significant Fuel-Consumption Gains
items.text: A new, sharp entry twin-stepped hull, more efficient than ever, resulting in an ultra-low cruising consumption of 2.4l/nm at 30 knots with 2 x Mercury V8 FourStroke 300hp. Considerable improvements of up to 30% better fuel economy across the 20 to 40 knot speed range.

items.name: Axopar Connect
items.title: Axopar Connect
items.text: Our Axopar Connect app brings smarter, more personal boating to life. With remote access to your boat's systems, real-time safety alerts, and customizable settings, the app transforms how you interact with your vessel. The intuitive user interface, on Simrad's multifunction displays, offers seamless control over navigation, diagnostics, and entertainment.

If your adventures include a lot of socializing and lounging, the U-Sofa aft configuration, which serves as both a dining spot and a lounging spot, is your option.
The renewed front cabin now has new materials and colors, which makes the space even lighter than before.

Inspired by a laid-back Mediterranean spirit and a love for lounging and socialising onboard, we have developed the new Mediterrana Edition. Now we have fully utilized the perfect layout of the Axopar 37s, further enhancing their appearance with a more relaxed, elegant look and greater on-board comfort.

sections.title: Upgrade Options
sections.intro: Elevate your Axopar 37 with the stylish BRABUS Line for a refined, premium look and feel — or choose the BRABUS Performance Line for extra power and exhilarating speed. For those who value ultimate comfort, the Mediterrana Edition and Soft Decking create a luxurious onboard experience, perfect for lounging and entertaining.

items.title: The Iconic Edition
modal_text:
The Iconic Edition features the ever-so-popular BRABUS Line, offering refined interior and exterior styling enhancements with subtle yet distinctive design details.

The Iconic Edition features the familiar, beloved BRABUS Line colors: Miami Blue and Platinum Grey. Additionally, we are spicing things up with two new colors, familiar from the BRABUS Marine lineup: Glacier Blue and Icon Grey.

Show your personality by choosing your favorites among Silvertex Petrol with Seine PE Steel accents, Silvertex Sandstone with Seine PE Taupe accents, Silvertex Cobre with Seine PE Ochre accents, or Silvertex Baltic with Seine PE Navy accents to match your adventure spirit.

We're sweetening the deal with the widely popular Roof Racks in black and the Electric Sliding Roof to make it even easier for you to bring your favorite gear along on your adventures.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line is a thrilling extension to the BRABUS Line that boosts the performance and enhances the boat’s appearance with a stylish hull & roof wrap. The BRABUS Performance Line includes stylish hull and roof graphics, plus more power at the transom with Twin Mercury Verado V10 400hp to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
The upholstery features exclusive, subtle yet stylish detailing with accentuated patterns, and a structured feel of marine fabrics, complemented by contrast-colored pillows and piping details.

The Mediterrana Edition features and options:

Outdoor waterproof fabric.

Fixed, extended foredeck seating/sunbed with armrests and storage under sunbed extension, including harbor cover.

Sunpad extension on top of gullwing doors.

Fixed, length-adjustable driver/co-pilot sofa with foldable backrest & flip-up bolsters, including harbor cover.

Aft sofa in the cockpit with a large center storage module, including a harbor cover.

Adjustable table in the cockpit (option)

Sunpad extension for cockpit (option - only with high/low table)

Mediterrana sundeck cushions for multi-storage incl. harbor cover (option)

Mediterrana sundeck cushions for aft cabin incl. harbor cover (option)

Extended seating cushions on top of aft fender storage hatches and anchor hatch

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 37 Sun Top comes with a spacious open aft deck. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Wet Bar, Multi Storage Compartment, U-Sofa, or Aft Cabin.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior and interior layouts available.
